description.short: Fine-tune your webcam — crop, zoom, align, and blur, right in your browser.
description.long: CamTuner is a browser extension for professional webcam framing: crop, zoom, and align your live camera feed, lock aspect ratios, keep yourself centered with Center Stage tracking, and blur or replace your background. Built with React and TypeScript.

description.full: Crop, zoom, and align your live camera feed directly in your browser. Free Chrome extension for professional webcam framing on Google Meet and Zoom.
